# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b79 — Room-centric configuration

Beta79 retains Beta78 occupancy authority, Beta77 verified device power recovery, the dry-only humidity target correction, and the existing controller, relay, compressor, window, and sleep protections.

## Reconfigure and Configure

The previous nine disconnected configuration sections are replaced by a single room-centric menu:

- **Choose rooms** — select monitored Home Assistant areas while preserving unaffected room/device settings.
- **Settings · <room>**, one entry for each previously monitored room — edit all that room's source groups together: windows, air quality, temperature, humidity, pressure, climate devices, window shades and selected occupancy/presence sensors. Existing selections are retained and an explicit empty group stays empty.
- **General settings** — a consolidated page for the occupied-room list and its state/attribute, sleeping-room list, home/away sensors, weather, outdoor sources, alerts, delivery targets, AI and language, pollen, global thresholds and timing.

Menus use the real HA Area Registry names and are localized for Greek, German, English, and all shipped language packs. No static room-name assumptions are made. Initial setup remains separate.

## Safety and persistence

Changing source inventories does not grant automatic operation of equipment. Existing per-device PID and safety settings remain on their entities. Removing a room or physical device follows the existing explicit safety revocation path. Configure and native Reconfigure preserve simultaneous unrelated option changes through the existing three-way merge.

No Home Assistant restart, equipment command or configuration mutation is performed by running the CI or building this release.

## Validation

The version-gated publisher runs the actual Beta79 room and General form tests, all 38 translation catalogs and current menu shapes, the Beta78 authoritative occupancy fallback tests, the Beta77/75/74/73/72 power-supply/compressor ownership and restart regressions, and the established HA event-stream and real Chromium dashboard checks. Only a successful release run publishes the prerelease ZIP.

## Installation

Update the existing Home Environment Manager via HACS to **v0.6.0b79**, restart Home Assistant and hard-refresh the dashboard. Open **Reconfigure** or **Configure** to find Choose rooms, per-room Settings and General settings. Do not create a second integration.
